name: Broker Network Throughput
programText:
raw_in = data('kafka_server_brokertopicmetrics_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker') and filter('name', 'BytesInPerSec')).sum()
((raw_in - raw_in.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='bytes_in')
raw_out = data('kafka_server_brokertopicmetrics_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-broker') and filter('name', 'BytesOutPerSec')).sum()
((raw_out - raw_out.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='bytes_out')
